rdf:Description.dc:title: Waffle Vendor on the Mall
rdf:Description.dc:description: Much like the food trucks that line the Mall today, food wagons in the late 1800s catered to office workers and tourists. Here a wagon offering "Hot Waffles 6 for 5c" sits on the Mall near the southside of the Treasury Department building.
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Uriah Hunt Painter (photographer)
rdf:Description.dc:source: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division. View Original.
